'''Vodokrene''' was a product that was packaged into cases. [[Unidentified Ho'Din proprietor|The Ho'Din]] proprietor of a [[Unidentified Drev'starn tapcafe|tapcafe]] in [[Drev'starn]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], stored several cases of vodokrene in his storage subbasement.<ref name="VtF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din's]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] was located two blocks from Bothawui's [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield generator]] and on top of an underground conduit carrying power cables to the facility. For this reason, [[Klif]] and [[Drend Navett]], two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]], dug through the subbasement floor<ref name="VtF" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Vision of the Future]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> in order to sabotage the planetary shields. When not working, they hid their equipment behind stacks of vodokrene cases. Returning to their work after a brief interruption, Navett discovered that a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] had been added to their equipment behind the vodokrene stacks, left by a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Moranda Savich|agent]] who wanted to spook the pair.<ref name="VtF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Timothy Zahn]] created vodokrene for his novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', published in [[1998]].<ref name="VtF" />
